paragraphs.text: Miguel Lopez is a writer and former narrative and card designer at Wizards of the Coast .

Before he came to Wizards, he was the lead narrative designer an co-creator of the independently published Lancer table top roleplaying game. He started working as a Game Designer / Worldbuilder for Wizards of the Coast in October 2020. He contributed to the Magic Story for Zendikar Rising , Kaldheim , and The Brothers' War . He also wrote the Planeswalker's Guide to Streets of New Capenna , Planeswalker's Guide to The Lost Caverns of Ixalan and Planeswalker's Guide to Aetherdrift .
In February 2025 he left Wizards of the Coast to become Senior Narrative Designer at Bungie .
